{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
num_internal_test_orders = len(internal_test_orders)
print(f'Number of internal test orders: {num_internal_test_orders}')

# Filter for completed orders only and exclude internal test orders
df_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}')

total_revenue"}
